description: We are Akshita and Kanishk, a Manchester team on Earth System Trend Detective. Kanishk (MSc AI, University of Manchester) builds AI and web apps; Akshita (Actuarial Science and Maths) leads the statistics and the pitch. Together we won QuantiHack 2026 and placed 3rd at the AMD Developer Hackathon. We are building a website that shows whether an Earth variable is really changing, how fast and where. Our team is complete, but we’re happy to chat with other teams!
